author: HarryRules2002
body:
I thought of a cool idea I would like to see implemented. 

Basically if you're in game you could easily type in /topkills , /topdeaths , /topmonuments. I think it would be a good idea because instead of going onto the website to check you can easily run that command. Also you could do /topkillsweek , /topkillsmonth , /topkillsall. You can do that with monuments, kills and deaths.

Feedback is appreciated, thank you :D

-Harry
